name: Odoru Daisousasen: The Game - Sensuikan ni Sennyuu Seyo!
summary: This cinematic adventure game is based on the popular Japanese police series known as Bayside Shakedown. Players take on the role of investigators solving a submarine-related case that occurred between the events of the first and second movies. Gameplay involves assigning detectives to missions, collecting clues, questioning characters, and piecing together the mystery through logic and deduction in a story-focused adventure format.
